## ACTUAL ADOPTED BASE · sole Track P #1782

Continuing under the [C baseline update](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7156641469) and the already verified [ACTUAL RESUME](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7156341723). Individual GitHub reads and local Git agree that #1781 is merged and actual main is `629994f527ded64d755923dcf9a3df2de08eacf5` with tree `d45df85c468f20e6cebbb8479337373f5782ad4f` and ordered parents `32b63e7bea3be5fd6fafb9f11f8ea0a7fd2376cc`, `76acbe9e083b51fb955495bb6ec24b5579881c34`. CURRENT_SPEC selects Draft17.38. Main has the final #1781 tree. The original comparison pin `d121c79a0f3cb94da1d2d15aaf789cc16a6e94f0` differs in the two CMake timeout paths. [Main FULL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45573457420) and [PARTIAL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45573457410) are in progress at intake, with ASan Heavy already successful and no failed job observed.

Both the clean baseline and the candidate worktree start at the adopted commit. The transferred tracked patch equals the saved 11,208-byte checkpoint patch (SHA-256 `d7fe86766fb79662db70199836146724694431864e6d7b045f21f0ad030fbed7`). All seven fixtures match the original frozen source bytes. The earlier [FIRST](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7154617402), [Gate0](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7154824647), prototype and raw observations retain their own pins. Next measurements are ordinary CLI on the clean adopted tree and focused private CHECK, C17, native and rollback tests on the candidate. Independent F/R material exposure remains zero. Material actual-main or candidate findings take priority under STOP C.
